segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן שֵׁזוּרִי וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר לֹא נֶחְלְקוּ כּוּ׳ אִם כֵּן, מָה תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר ׳אֲשֶׁר חָטָא בָּהּ׳״? פְּרָט לַמִּתְעַסֵּק.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Shimon Shezuri say:» Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua «did not disagree» with regard to a case where his lack of knowledge involves items from one category. And the last clause in the mishna concludes: «If» it is «so, what» is the meaning when «the verse states:» “If his sin, «wherein he has sinned”» (Leviticus 4:23), from which it is derived that one is liable only if the object of the sin was the one he intended? It serves to «exclude one who acts unawares» and does not intend to perform a prohibited action at all.
